summary: Iteration 41 — 4 new features validated end-to-end. Backend (6/6 pytest passed, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_41_reply_disconnect.py): POST /api/projects/{id}/suggest-reply returns grounded reply (~323 chars) with reply/confidence/based_on/deep_links{gmail_web,mailto,slack_web}/grounded_in, works with instruction+history; DELETE /api/connect/connections/{id} returns {ok:true}, marks status=disconnected, removes from GET /api/projects/{id}/connections and GET /api/connect/connections; DELETE non-existent → 404; empty project (ca004e...) returns []. Frontend (Playwright, demo login via /login → 'I have a password'): Landing (/) renders refreshed hero ('Your client work. Remembered.', new subhead, Product Hunt badge, stats) — no console errors. Empty project /project/ca004e13... shows overview-empty-state + overview-empty-illustration + overview-empty-connect-cta (href=/app/connect?project=ca004e13...). Horizontal pills show Overview + 6 canonical categories exactly (Deliverables, Scope, Timeline, Requirements, Decisions, Deadlines). Connected project /project/9ea97afb... shows suggested-reply-chat + project-memory-sources, initial thread is empty (no auto-reply — verified chat-turn-assistant-0=0 on mount, 3 quick-prompt chips). Typing instruction + clicking send appends chat-turn-user-0 and chat-turn-assistant-1 with grounded reply referencing v2/Phase 1/cover redesign/testimonials/Feb 20 launch; all six action buttons present (copy/edit/regenerate/gmail/mailto/slack indexed as -1). 'New thread' clears (user_turn=0, empty=1). Disconnect: hover source row reveals project-memory-source-disconnect-{id}; click opens confirm dialog 'Disconnect Client thread — Nordwind?'; Confirm calls DELETE /api/connect/connections/{id}; row is removed and overview-empty-state now shows (fallback to empty state, as expected).

critical_code_review_comments: connectors.py now 1830 lines — file should be split (Connections API, Memory API, Digest, Suggest-reply into separate routers).

ProjectMemory.jsx is 940 lines mixing OverviewView, SuggestedReplyChat, ChatTurn, ConnectedSourcesCompact, EmptyOverviewIllustration and MemoryPane — split into per-component files for maintainability.
SuggestedReplyChat renders a Sparkles icon and quick-prompt chips but there is no aria-live region on the assistant turn — screen readers won't announce Bracket's draft when it arrives.

Disconnect confirmation dialog uses generic buttons 'Cancel'/'Disconnect' without data-testid — tests have to fall back to text selectors. Add data-testid="disconnect-confirm" / "disconnect-cancel" for stability.

Landing hero uses a large 'Remembered.' gradient — verify the gradient stays visible over the dark background on all breakpoints; on very narrow viewports the gradient shift might reduce contrast. Not observed on 1440×900.

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regressions. All 4 new features (chat suggest-reply, empty-state illustration + CTA, disconnect UX, refreshed marketing copy) and the pill regression pass.
